nethack.summary: Death is fully permanent. No respawn, no recovery. Character save file is deleted.

broguece.summary: Death is fully permanent. Single-character game with no respawn mechanic.

crawl.summary: Death is permanent. Save file is deleted upon death. No respawn or recovery mechanic.

cataclysm-bn.summary: Death is permanent by default. World persists but character is gone. Optional respawn via NPC revival mechanics in some mods.

nethack.summary: Dungeon levels are procedurally generated with persistent features. Branches have fixed structure but level contents are random.

broguece.summary: Fully procedural dungeon. Each level is randomly generated with no persistence between descents.

crawl.summary: Procedural dungeon generation with persistent branch structure. Levels regenerate if left and revisited after enough turns.

cataclysm-bn.summary: Overworld map is procedurally generated with fixed city layouts. Building interiors are randomly generated on entry.

nethack.summary: Inventory is item-based with letter slots. Items can be in main inventory, containers, or wielded. No weight system.

broguece.summary: Limited inventory slots. Items take specific slots. No weight system but slot count is constrained.

crawl.summary: Inventory uses letter slots with item stacking. No weight system. Containers available for storage.

cataclysm-bn.summary: Grid-based inventory with volume and weight system. Items occupy space in containers and vehicles. Detailed crafting dependencies.

nethack.summary: Scrolls, potions, rings, and wands start unidentified. Player uses trial, scrolls of identify, or divination to learn item types.

broguece.summary: Potions and scrolls are unidentified. Player learns types by trial. No scroll of identify — discovery is risk-based.

crawl.summary: Items are unidentified by default. Scrolls of identify, apportation, and shopkeepers help. Some items auto-id on use.

cataclysm-bn.summary: No traditional identification system. Items are known by default. Knowledge is gated by skill levels and books rather than item ID.

nethack.summary: Polytheistic system with three gods (Lawful, Neutral, Chaotic). Sacrifices, prayers, and gifts. Piety affects protection and crowning.

broguece.summary: No religion system. BrogueCE focuses on pure dungeon crawling without divine mechanics.

crawl.summary: Polytheistic with many gods offering different gifts and penances. Piety gained through offerings and behavior. Gods grant abilities at piety thresholds.

cataclysm-bn.summary: No traditional religion system. Some mods add cult or faith mechanics, but base game has no god worship.
